scams.name: Puerto Vallarta Airport (PVR) 'Shark Tank' Timeshare Ambush & Taxi Overcharge
scams.description: Puerto Vallarta International Airport (PVR) arrivals hall has Mexico's most-notorious 2025 timeshare-ambush ecosystem nicknamed 'the Shark Tank'. r/puertovallarta 'airport scam, save yourselves' (comments/1n6s9iq, 2025) is the CANONICAL 2025 first-person anchor. r/puertovallarta 'Shark Tank Scam!? Plz Help!' (comments/1n17kfi, 2025) is a second 2025 named anchor. r/puertovallarta 'Tourist Scams in PV' (comments/1jdksbw, 2025) and 'Let's talk about scams' (comments/1ind6hl, 2025) document the 2025 ecosystem. The 2025 scam patterns: (a) 'Shark Tank' — the area RIGHT after customs is lined with timeshare salespeople in polo shirts posing as 'tourist information' or 'hotel transfer' agents; opening line 'Where are you staying? I have a special discount' leads to 'free transport' in exchange for attending a 90-minute presentation; (b) 'transportation' arranged turns out to be Vidanta/Garza Blanca/Krystal shuttle direct to their resort, with lock-in pressure to attend a 3-5 hour presentation; (c) 'authorised taxi' counters inside terminal quoting MX$800–$1,500 for transfer to Zona Romántica (real Uber MX$250–$400); (d) fake 'hotel shuttle' sign-holders at arrivals intercepting guests whose hotels don't actually provide shuttle; (e) Uber cancellation scam similar to CDMX; (f) Garza Blanca specifically documented per r/puertovallarta 'Don't go to Garza Blanca - massive fraud schemes and bait' (comments/1jt1mqv, 2025). For older travellers: (1) WALK STRAIGHT through the 'Shark Tank' after customs — DO NOT stop, DO NOT engage, DO NOT answer 'Where are you staying?'; keep moving to the exit doors; (2) book Uber on airport Wi-Fi AFTER exiting the terminal — meet at the designated Uber pickup (across the bridge outside the main terminal, signposted); typical PVR to Zona Romántica MX$250–$400; (3) alternatively use the official SITUR taxi kiosk OUTSIDE the terminal at MX$450–$650 to Zona Romántica (legitimate but overpriced); (4) if your hotel genuinely includes airport shuttle, CONFIRM the driver's sign shows your hotel's correct logo AND your name — request via WhatsApp before departure; (5) REFUSE every 'timeshare', 'special transport', 'resort information' offer in the Shark Tank; (6) Vidanta, Garza Blanca, Villa del Palmar, and Villa Group are legitimate resorts BUT their presentations are 3-5 hour high-pressure sales per r/puertovallarta 'Vidanta Nuevo Vallarta: Timeshare sales pitch' (comments/17oe5gd); (7) save US Consulate Guadalajara +52 33 3268 2100 if pressured at airport.
scams.avoidance: WALK STRAIGHT through Shark Tank; don't stop or engage Book Uber outside terminal after exiting: MX$250–$400 to Zona Romántica OR official SITUR taxi kiosk OUTSIDE: MX$450–$650 Verify hotel shuttle driver's sign (hotel logo + your name) US Consulate Guadalajara +52 33 3268 2100 if pressured
scams.location: PVR airport arrivals 'Shark Tank' zone (right after customs), Terminal 2 taxi kiosks, 'authorised transfer' counters, Nuevo Vallarta/Zona Romántica drop-offs

scams.name: Puerto Vallarta Timeshare 'Breakfast Presentation' High-Pressure Extortion
scams.description: Puerto Vallarta hosts some of Mexico's most aggressive 2025 timeshare-presentation operations, with Garza Blanca and Vidanta Nuevo Vallarta specifically named in community coverage. r/puertovallarta 'What is with the hard sell on the breakfast presentation' (comments/1ksvts0, 2025) is a CANONICAL 2025 named anchor. r/puertovallarta "Don't go to Garza Blanca - massive fraud schemes and bait" (comments/1jt1mqv, 2025) is a specific-property 2025 warning. r/puertovallarta 'Vidanta Nuevo Vallarta: Timeshare sales pitch' (comments/17oe5gd) is the baseline. r/puertovallarta 'The Villa Group salesman asked me to write down my' (comments/1hlsg2w, 2024) documents specific high-pressure tactics. The 2025 scam patterns: (a) 'free breakfast + US$200 resort credit + US$150 excursion voucher' for a '90-minute no-obligation presentation'; (b) presentation actually runs 3-5 HOURS with rotating 'closer' agents and psychological pressure ('sign today or lose the discount'); (c) 'The Villa Group' salesman tactic of asking tourists to 'write down personal goals' to create emotional attachment; (d) deposit-trap — 'US$5,000 deposit secures today's price' (actually binding); (e) 'cancellation fee US$500' if you try to exit early; (f) 'manager' arrives to pressure when you decline; (g) 'closing room' physical isolation with 'financial counsel' pushing mortgage-style commitments; (h) 'limited time only — this offer expires when you leave the room' psychological urgency. For older travellers: (1) JUST SAY NO at resort welcome desks — the 'free' perks are never worth 3–5 hours of high-pressure sales and real financial risk; (2) if already in presentation, set a HARD TIME LIMIT and stand up to walk out at exactly 90 minutes regardless of tactics; (3) NEVER authorise credit-card 'holds' or 'deposits' during presentation; (4) NEVER write down 'personal goals' or 'retirement plans' — per r/puertovallarta 'The Villa Group salesman' (comments/1hlsg2w, 2024), this is used for psychological manipulation; (5) if pressured to stay, firm 'Necesito hablar con mi esposo/a/abogado' (I need to speak with spouse/lawyer) + walk out; (6) Mexican 5-business-day cooling-off period is LAW — file cancellation via PROFECO (profeco.gob.mx) + registered mail to property's legal department; (7) r/puertovallarta "Don't go to Garza Blanca" (comments/1jt1mqv, 2025) has specific anti-presentation tactics for that property; (8) if pressured or detained, call US Consulate Guadalajara +52 33 3268 2100.
scams.avoidance: JUST SAY NO at resort welcome desks — never engage with perks offer If in presentation, 90-min timer; stand and walk out NEVER authorise credit-card 'holds' or 'deposits' NEVER write down 'personal goals' or 'retirement plans' Mexican 5-day cooling-off: file PROFECO if signed; US Consulate +52 33 3268 2100
scams.location: Garza Blanca Resort, Vidanta Nuevo Vallarta, Villa del Palmar, Pueblo Bonito, Grand Mayan, Villa Group properties, Zona Hotelera pool-deck 'welcome desks'

scams.name: Puerto Vallarta Uber Cancellation & 'Airport Uber Ban' Misdirection
scams.description: Puerto Vallarta has complex 2025 Uber regulatory dynamics that scammers exploit. Uber IS legal in PV — but taxi drivers aggressively spread 'Uber is banned at airport' misinformation. r/puertovallarta 'Airport/Uber' (comments/1nzdvca, 2025) is a 2025 named anchor. r/puertovallarta 'Airport transfer or Uber' (comments/1p6vld4, 2025) is a 2025 community thread. r/puertovallarta 'Uber at Airport' (comments/1olw4t5, 2025) covers the 2025 airport-specific rules. The 2025 scam patterns: (a) taxi drivers at PVR airport claiming 'Uber is illegal here' — Uber IS legal but pickups must happen OUTSIDE the terminal (across the pedestrian bridge at the Sheraton hotel area), not inside; (b) taxi drivers physically blocking Uber pickup zones; (c) 'VIP private driver' quotes at MX$1,500 for Zona Romántica (real Uber MX$250–$400); (d) Uber driver cancellation + re-quote scam (same as CDMX pattern); (e) 'app broken, WhatsApp please' off-app negotiation at 2–3x rate; (f) Malecón evening 'pirate taxi' approaches at Zona Romántica nightlife exits with MX$400 flat rate for a 5-min ride; (g) hotel-lobby bellhop kickbacks directing to 'recommended' taxi at 2x Uber rate. For older travellers: (1) Uber IS legal in Puerto Vallarta — ignore 'Uber banned here' claims; (2) for PVR airport, WALK OUT of terminal, cross the pedestrian bridge to the Sheraton hotel zone (100m), and request Uber pickup there — typical fare MX$250–$400 to Zona Romántica; (3) Uber drivers are prohibited from curbside airport pickups (regulatory, not illegal) — this is why 'off-site pickup' is required; (4) pay in-app ONLY — NEVER WhatsApp, cash, or off-app negotiation; (5) REFUSE every 'VIP private driver' quote above MX$700; (6) for nightlife returns (11 PM+), your hotel can call a safe taxi OR book Uber in advance; avoid Malecón 'pirate taxi' approaches; (7) if Uber driver requests cancellation, decline and rebook yourself; (8) save numbers: US Consulate PV +52 322 222 0069, Policía Turística +52 322 224 0061; (9) r/puertovallarta 'Uber at Airport' (comments/1olw4t5, 2025) has current 2025 airport-pickup logistics.
scams.avoidance: Uber IS legal in PV; airport pickup is at Sheraton bridge 100m from terminal PVR to Zona Romántica via Uber: MX$250–$400 Pay in-app ONLY; never WhatsApp or cash; refuse cancellation requests For nightlife returns, hotel-called taxi or pre-booked Uber US Consulate PV +52 322 222 0069
scams.location: PVR airport, Zona Romántica pickup zones, Malecón waterfront evenings, Nuevo Vallarta hotel corridor, Marina Vallarta taxi queues

scams.name: Zona Romántica & Malecón Restaurant Tourist-Menu Bill-Padding
scams.description: Puerto Vallarta's tourist-heavy dining strip hosts a 2025 bill-padding ecosystem. r/puertovallarta 'Zona Romantica Tourist Guide' (comments/1p7g2cl, 2025) is the 2025 named community anchor. r/puertovallarta 'Tourist Scams in PV' (comments/1jdksbw, 2025) and 'Let's talk about scams' (comments/1ind6hl, 2025) document the patterns. r/puertovallarta 'Going to PV for the first time, staying in the Zona Romántica' (comments/1b2yflh, 2023) is a community baseline. The 2025 scam patterns: (a) Malecón waterfront restaurants with English-only menus at 2–3x Spanish menu prices (fish tacos MX$180 vs MX$50 at locally-oriented Zona Romántica); (b) 'gratuity 18%' pre-added PLUS tip line (double-tipping); (c) 'seafood market price' verbal quotes at MX$1,200–$2,500 per lobster without weight disclosed; (d) 'credit-card processing 10–15%' announced at bill (legitimate 0–3%); (e) USD-priced menus with 10–15% padded exchange vs MX$; (f) bill switcheroo — itemised receipt ≠ card swipe total; (g) 'free' complimentary appetizer that appears as MX$250 'botana' charge on bill; (h) 'live music service charge MX$100/person' added unannounced during dinner. For older travellers: (1) eat at Zona Romántica LOCAL spots (not the Malecón tourist strip): El Arrayán (Güemes 277), La Leche (Marcela Valadez 195), Barcelona Tapas (Matamoros 906), Joe Jack's Fish Shack — all Google 4.7+ at MX$200–$450 per meal; (2) for seafood, agree weight × price/kg IN WRITING before cooking; fair fish MX$200–$500/kg depending on type; (3) inspect bill line-by-line — 'gratuity 18%' means NO additional tip; (4) confirm credit-card surcharge 0–3% BEFORE ordering; refuse 10–15% charges; (5) request MX$ bill (not USD); (6) refuse 'complimentary' botanas/appetizers arriving uninvited — they're never free; (7) for Malecón dining, prefer established landmark restaurants (La Palapa, The River Café) — transparent pricing; (8) r/puertovallarta 'Zona Romantica Tourist Guide' (comments/1p7g2cl, 2025) has 2025 venue recommendations.
scams.avoidance: Eat Zona Romántica local (not Malecón): El Arrayán, La Leche, Barcelona Seafood: agree weight × price/kg IN WRITING before cooking Inspect bill; refuse 'gratuity + tip' double-dipping Card surcharge 0–3% max; refuse 10–15% charges Request MX$ bill (not USD); refuse uninvited botanas
scams.location: Zona Romántica (Old Town) restaurants, Malecón waterfront dining, Olas Altas beach-area tourist bars, Basilio Badillo 'restaurant row'

scams.name: Puerto Vallarta Beach Vendor & 'Friendly Photographer' Tip Scam
scams.description: Puerto Vallarta's public beaches host a 2025 vendor and unsolicited-photo scam ecosystem. r/puertovallarta 'Tourist Scams in PV' (comments/1jdksbw, 2025), 'Let's talk about scams' (comments/1ind6hl, 2025), and 'Zona Romantica Tourist Guide' (comments/1p7g2cl, 2025) document the pattern. r/puertovallarta 'Going to PV for the first time' (comments/1b2yflh, 2023) covers beach-specific community insight. The 2025 scam patterns: (a) beach vendors walking up with sarongs/jewelry/henna tattoos — aggressive initial pitch, vague 'whatever you want to pay' response, then demand MX$500–$1,200 at end; (b) 'free henna tattoo' that becomes MX$400 when you try to leave; (c) 'friendly local photographer' offering to take family photos with your phone then demanding MX$200–$500 tip; (d) 'buy one get one free' coconut/fruit offers where the 'free' one is the one you paid markup for; (e) 'massage on the beach MX$400 for 60 min' that ends with MX$1,200 bill for 'extended service'; (f) 'mariachi musician approach' — 3–5 musicians surround your table, play without asking, then demand MX$300–$500 'tip' (legitimate mariachi are pre-paid at restaurants); (g) beach-club 'entry fee US$40 per person' at free public beaches like Los Muertos. For older travellers: (1) firm 'no gracias' and keep walking — don't stop or engage beach vendors; (2) Playa Los Muertos is FREE public beach — no entry fee needed; beach-chair rental at legitimate clubs is MX$200–$400; (3) REFUSE every 'free' offer — henna, photos, fruit, appetizers — if accepted, negotiate price BEFORE service; (4) for photos, take them YOURSELF with phone timer OR ask a restaurant server at your table (small tip); (5) REFUSE mariachi approach unless you actively WANT a song — if you want music, go to Plaza de Armas where fixed-price mariachi perform (MX$100–$200 per song negotiated upfront); (6) for beach massage, book inland at Google 4.7+ spas (Spa Imagine, Terra Noble) at MX$1,000–$1,500 for proper 60-min; (7) coconut/fruit vendor: ask price BEFORE and count change; fair MX$50–$80 for opened coconut; (8) all Mexican beaches are PUBLIC under federal law — no beach club can deny you waterline access; walk through firmly if challenged.
scams.avoidance: Firm 'no gracias' and keep walking; no engagement REFUSE every 'free' offer; negotiate price BEFORE service Take photos yourself with phone timer OR restaurant server Mariachi MX$100–$200 per song, agreed upfront at Plaza de Armas Beach massage: book Spa Imagine, Terra Noble at MX$1,000–$1,500
scams.location: Playa Los Muertos public beach, Malecón waterfront, Marina Vallarta beach-front, Mismaloya Beach, beach-club entry approaches

scams.name: Puerto Vallarta ATM DCC & Hotel Currency Exchange Padding
scams.description: Puerto Vallarta shares the Mexico-wide 2025 ATM DCC fraud + hotel exchange padding pattern. r/puertovallarta "Let's talk about scams" (comments/1ind6hl, 2025) is the 2025 community overview. r/MexicoCity 'A tip for tourists: When using the ATM, do NOT accept' (comments/1e6hw8v, 2024) is the canonical DCC anchor. r/cancun 'Best way to exchange USD for Peso's?' (comments/1pr3h2m, 2025) is the 2025 regional exchange anchor. The 2025 scam patterns: (a) freestanding Malecón ATMs with 'home currency conversion?' DCC prompts at 8–15% padded rates; (b) Nuevo Vallarta resort lobby ATMs (Cardtronics, EuroNet) with MX$150–$250 fees PLUS DCC; (c) resort reception USD-to-pesos at MX$16–$17 per US$1 when Bank of Mexico rate is MX$18.5 (8–15% padded); (d) Zona Romántica OXXO ATMs with transaction-cancel fraud (cash not dispensed but account debited); (e) 'dollar acceptance at hotel shops' pricing at 10–15% padded exchange; (f) 'cash back' at pharmacies/stores at terrible rates; (g) Marina Vallarta cruise-pier ATMs targeted by skimmer rings; (h) tourist-menu restaurants asking '¿Dollars or pesos?' with MX$-posted prices but dollar charge at MX$16 exchange. For older travellers: (1) use ONLY ATMs INSIDE bank branches — HSBC, Banamex, Santander, BBVA — in Zona Romántica or downtown PV, during business hours (9 AM–4 PM Mon–Fri); (2) when ATM asks 'home currency conversion?', ALWAYS select 'NO' or 'Continue in MX Pesos'; (3) set LOW daily limits (MX$3,000) + transaction alerts; (4) bring US$200–$400 cash emergency buffer; exchange SMALL amounts at legitimate casa de cambio (Zona Romántica, NOT hotels) at MX$18.3–$18.7 per US$1; (5) AVOID Nuevo Vallarta resort USD-to-pesos at MX$16 — 12% padded; (6) for daily spending, use tap-to-pay credit card — interbank rate 1–2% better than ATM; (7) dedicated travel debit card (not primary account); (8) decline restaurants asking '¿Dollars?' — always pay in pesos at MX$-posted price; (9) RFID-blocking wallet for contactless cards; (10) Marina Vallarta cruise-pier area: AVOID pier-side ATMs, use inland bank branches instead.
scams.avoidance: Use bank-branch ATMs (HSBC, Banamex, Santander, BBVA) business hours only ALWAYS select 'NO / Continue in MX$' for DCC prompt Set MX$3,000 daily limit + transaction alerts Exchange at Zona Romántica casa de cambio, not Nuevo Vallarta hotels Pay in pesos always; tap-to-pay credit card beats ATM
scams.location: Malecón freestanding ATMs, Zona Romántica OXXO/Cardtronics ATMs, Nuevo Vallarta resort lobby ATMs, Marina Vallarta cruise-pier ATMs
